title: P.5 Exponential and Logarithmic Functions

icans: I can graph exponential functions and give their domain, range, and asymptote.
I can explain what the number e is and use natural logarithms.
I can find the domain of a logarithmic function and solve exponential and logarithmic equations.

vocab: the base of the ______________ function whose tangent line at (0, 1) has slope 1; e ≈ 2.718

blocks.p: Graph y = aˣ (slider for a) and y = x + 1.

head: a
rows: Does the line cross or touch the curve at (0, 1)?

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: f(x) = aˣ: domain all real numbers, range (0, ∞), horizontal asymptote y = 0, and the graph contains (0, 1), (1, a), and (−1, _______________).

blocks.stem: Use transformations to graph f(x) = 2^(x + 2). Give the domain, range, and asymptote.

notes: The number e: the tangent line to y = eˣ at (0, 1) has slope _______________.

blocks.stem: Graph f(x) = 5 − eˣ. Give the range and asymptote.

notes: Logarithms: y = logₐ x means x = _______________; the domain of logₐ x is (0, ∞).

blocks.stem:
Find the domain of each function.
a.  F(x) = log₂ x²
b.  g(x) = 8 + 5 ln(2x + 3)
c.  f(x) = ln(x − 1)

notes: Inverse properties: ln eˣ = x for all real x, and e^(ln x) = _______________ for x > 0.

blocks.stem:
Solve.
a.  log₂(2x + 1) = 3
b.  ln(2x + 3) = 2 ln 3
Solve e^(1 − 2x) = 4. Give the exact answer and a decimal.

tickets.stem: Find the domain of f(x) = ln(x − 1).
